tools.name: lookup_phone
tools.description: Identify the country and mobile operator of a phone number and list the top-up offers available for it. Free. The operator is DETECTED from the number range and is a guess: MVNOs (Tesco Mobile, Giff Gaff, Lebara, Voxi, Sky…) resolve to the host network they ride on. Read the detected brand back to t

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Browse purchasable offers: mobile top-ups, travel eSIMs, prepaid bills, or international payment corridors (bank / mobile money / UPI) for a country. Free. Prices shown are indicative; the quote fixes them.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Lock a price (10 minutes) for one purchase. Returns quoteId, exact USDC price and what will be delivered. Free. ALWAYS show the human the price and the recipient before buying.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Get the x402 payment challenge for a quote. This hosted server holds no wallet, so it does NOT spend your money: it returns the exact amount, asset, payTo address and facilitator for you to pay from your own Algorand wallet, then you POST the quote again with your payment signature. Requires prior h

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Check an order. Poll every ~3 s until `terminal` is true: delivered (confirmation + signed receipt), refunded (refund txid + signed receipt) or refund_failed.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an ed25519-signed receipt: the signature, and — unless you pass onChain:false — both txids against an Algorand indexer. Give it an orderId to check one of this service's own orders, or a receipt object to check ANY receipt in this format, including one issued by another server.

tools.name: fx
tools.description: Indicative USDC → local-currency rate at our sale price, with an estimate for an amount. The quote is the binding price.

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Public delivery ledger: totals, delivered-or-refunded %, volume, countries, recent orders.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buy · Private data: buy · Public sink: buy · Destructive: verify_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buy · Private data: buy · Public sink: buy · Destructive: verify_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
